description: This file defines a client-side React component for a note-taking web application, including state management, local storage integration, UI layout, and user interactions.
published: default export of the Home component

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from local storage or provides seed notes if none are stored or an error occurs.

methods.name: saveNotes
methods.description: Saves the current notes array to local storage.

methods.name: loadSelected
methods.description: Fetches the ID of the currently selected note from local storage.

methods.name: saveSelected
methods.description: Saves the ID of the selected note to local storage.

methods.name: cx
methods.description: Utility function to compose class names conditionally.

methods.name: timeAgo
methods.description: Calculates and returns a relative time string (e.g., '5m ago') based on a timestamp.
